Frequently Asked Questions
What happens if I exceed my yearly AEH allocation?

We'll notify you when you're approaching your limit. You can purchase additional AEH packages or upgrade to a higher tier. Your agents will continue to work without interruption.

Can I bring my own LLM?

Yes! Enterprise plans include the option to bring your own LLM, giving you full control over your AI infrastructure while leveraging Kubiya's orchestration capabilities.

Is there a long-term commitment required?

Yes, all plans require yearly commitments. This gives you the flexibility to consume your AEH retainer at your own pace throughout the year. We also offer 2-month pilot programs that can convert to yearly agreements.

How do unused AEHs roll over?

Your AEH retainer is valid for one year from purchase. Any unused hours expire at the end of your contract term. Enterprise customers can discuss custom rollover terms as part of their agreements.
